svg.title: WARHEATMAP - WHAT IS ACTUALLY ON THE MAP
svg.desc: Measured from the live warheatmap.app sitemap on 2026-09-20: 6,983 individually indexed conflict event pages. Event type and severity proportions come from a random sample of 260 of those pages, read directly from the site. The sample contains 17 event types, 4 severity tiers, 32 named conflicts and 168 distinct cited news sources.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Counts are a 260-page random sample of the 6,983, so these are proportions and not totals. Every figure was read from the live site.

svg.text: 168 distinct outlets in that sample - Al Jazeera 12, Kyiv Independent 9, The Guardian 8, Anadolu Agency 8, Reuters 6, Sudan Tribune 6, UN News 5.
